messages.subject: shareFactorLevels not working
parts:
Dear Murray,
I'm having trouble getting the function shareFactorLevels to work. In the initial creation of capthist I get the expected error from verify. Using shareFactorLevels seems to fix the problem until I try to run a model that includes the covariate. Models with other variables seem to be working. Number of occasions does vary between sessions (4, 4, 6). 
Any help you can provide is much appreciated.
Thanks,
Cheryl

> BLwarren<-read.capthist(captfile="2018_2019_BL_SECR_capturedata.txt",
+                   trapfile = list("2018_BL_SECR_traplocs.txt",
+                                   "2019MAY_BL_SECR_traplocs.txt",
+                                   "2019AUG_BL_SECR_traplocs.txt"),
+                   detector = "multi",
+                   fmt=c("trapID","XY"),
+                   covnames=list("Sex"),
+                   trapcovnames = list("Warren"),
+                   verify=TRUE)
No errors found :-)
Warning messages:
1: In make.capthist(captures = capturelist[[i]], traps = trps, fmt = fmt,  :
  dropping repeat detections within occasions at exclusive detectors (traps)
2: In verify.capthist(temp) :
  Levels of factor covariate(s) differ between sessions - use shareFactorLevels()
> BLwarren <- shareFactorLevels(BLwarren)#uneven factors for traps this fixes it
> verify(BLwarren)
No errors found :-)

...

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: shareFactorLevels not working
parts:
Cheryl
Thanks for sending the data.
shareFactorLevels is working. You have inconsistent factor levels for both an individual covariate (Sex) and a trap covariate (Warren). Your application of sharefactorLevels (to BLwarren) fixed the Sex issue (including 'unknown' as a level for all sessions). To fix the Warren issue I think you need to input the trap data separately e.g.
trps <- read.traps(c("2018_BL_SECR_traplocs.txt",
                     "2019MAY_BL_SECR_traplocs.txt",
                     "2019AUG_BL_SECR_traplocs.txt"),
                   detector = "multi",
                   covnames = "Warren"
)
trps <- shareFactorLevels(trps)   # fix trap covariate(s)

BLwarren <- make.capthist(
    captures = read.table("2018_2019_BL_SECR_capturedata.txt"),
    traps = trps, covnames = "Sex"
)
BLwarren <- shareFactorLevels(BLwarren)   # fix individual covariate(s)

Murray
